notes:
Summary: Enterprise trading platform evaluating Redwood for trade surveillance, chat assistant for traders, and reranking for signal pipelines. Heavy FINRA/regulatory scrutiny.

Highlights:
- 2024-06-11: Intro call w/ Jordan P., Head of Trading (Alex S.), and CTO (Priya R.). Good product fit on capabilities.
- AE notes: "Interest strong for private deployments; primary ask = FINRA-approved hosting or clear SOC2+FINRA attestation."
- 2024-07-02: SE deep-dive (Maya) on architecture; Cerulean requested network diagram, key rotation flow, and audit log retention policy.
- 2024-07-21: Security review completed internally, flagged FINRA as blocker — legal requires broker-dealer ops to host certain models in FINRA-cleared environments.
- 2024-08-13: Compliance call (FF-2024-08-13-cerulean-1). Legal insisted on a hardened private offering, with documented FINRA precedents. Redwood provided draft architecture and drive link to security FAQ.
- 2024-09-05: Final procurement review; CFO announced company-wide hiring and procurement freeze for Q4 — hold on all new vendor commitments over $100k.
- 2024-09-12: Competitor (VectorServe AI) confirmed they can provide an audited FINRA-friendly managed environment through partner; Cerulean signaled preference to move forward with them.

POC/Technical: POC scoped for reranking + embeddings, 3-week timebox, required sample data residency in us-east-1, key management via customer KMS, strict audit retention (7 years).

Decision rationale (from Cerulean): "We need formal FINRA attestation and a single-vendor pledge on data residency + KMS — without that our compliance team will not approve."

Sales status: Marked closed-lost due to regulatory blocker & budget freeze. Internal ask: preserve architecture notes and security artifacts; document competitor claims for future rebuttal.
